mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER' AND u.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER' AND u.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND u.created_at >= #{todayStart} AND u.created_at < #{tomorrowStart}) AS todayNewUsers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FROM ( SELECT d.user_id FROM diet_records d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.created_at >= #{rangeStart} AND d.created_at < #{rangeEnd} UNION ALL SELECT s.user_id FROM slot_spins s WHERE s.created_at >= #{rangeStart} AND s.created_at < #{rangeEnd} ) a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER') AS activeUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diet_records d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.business_date BETWEEN #{businessStart} AND #{businessEnd}) AS dietRecords, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slot_spins s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER' AND s.created_at >= #{rangeStart} AND s.created_at < #{rangeEnd}) AS slotSpins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slot_spins s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER' AND s.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND s.created_at >= #{rangeStart} AND s.created_at < #{rangeEnd}) AS slotConfirmed

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(u.created_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER' AND u.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND u.created_at >= #{rangeStart} AND u.created_at < #{rangeEnd} GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(u.created_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'))

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM diet_records d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.business_date BETWEEN #{businessStart} AND #{businessEnd} GROUP BY d.business_date

SELECT d.source, COUNT(*) AS count FROM diet_records d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.code = 'USER' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.business_date BETWEEN #{businessStart} AND #{businessEnd} AND d.source IN ('MANUAL', 'SLOT') GROUP BY d.source
